summary: Phase 5 testing complete. Backend: 68/68 pytest PASS (54 carry-over + 14 new Phase 5 cases). All Phase 5 features verified end-to-end: (1) Auto-login redirects / -> /dashboard with cookies + bearer token, (2) Real RSS news from MoneyControl/ET Markets/LiveMint/ET Stocks aggregated in /api/news (37 articles seen), (3) News search filter functional on /news, (4) Trade Journal /journal renders Total P&L, Win Rate, All-Time Performance, AI Performance Review (Generate Review button), and Trade History rows, (5) /api/analysis/full-report returns confidence_score, full scoring_breakdown (RSI/Volume/Price Action/VWAP/News Sentiment), dual AI debate (Claude+Gemini+verdict) and related_news, (6) Zerodha keys configured – /api/zerodha/status and /api/data-sources both report configured=true, (7) Sidebar contains News + Journal links alongside Dashboard/Picks/Trades/Portfolio/AI Chat/SIP/Settings, (8) Stock detail page /stock/RELIANCE renders TradingView candlestick + volume chart with 1D/1W/1M switcher, RSI/MACD/Volume Ratio indicators and Market Cap/PE/Day Range/52W. Portfolio Monitor present on dashboard.

minor.issue: Auto-login is a GET with no auth/role check — anyone hitting the URL is granted an admin JWT+cookies. Acceptable for dev-mode flag, but must be gated behind an env flag (e.g., ENABLE_AUTO_LOGIN) before production.
Trade journal cutoff variable is computed but not applied to the Mongo filter — days param has no effect on the returned list (only the .to_list(200) cap matters).
Carry-over: no HMAC signature verification — anyone can POST fake order events.
Carry-over: still accepts unauthenticated user_id via query string.

integration_issues.issue: Picks page body text is sparse (~840 chars) and no 'Full Report' / 'Confidence' visible immediately. Likely renders a loading placeholder while POST /api/analysis/top-picks runs (AI heavy). Backend full-report API itself returns scoring breakdown correctly (verified in pytest). Suggest adding a clear loading skeleton + data-testid='full-report-btn' so it can be reliably exercised.

issues: MoneyControl Markets entries include raw HTML in summary preview (visible escaped tags). Should strip HTML from RSS summary before render.
Ticker bar text overflows behind sidebar on first symbol (left-most ticker partially hidden).

action_items: Gate /api/auth/auto-login behind ENABLE_AUTO_LOGIN env flag before production. Currently any unauthenticated visitor receives an admin JWT.
Fix /api/journal: apply the computed `cutoff` to the Mongo query (`exit_time: {$gte: cutoff}`) so the `days` query param actually limits results.
Sanitize RSS article['summary'] (strip / HTML) in services/news_service.py before returning to frontend so /news doesn't show raw HTML tags.
Add data-testid='full-report-btn' on AI Picks card and a visible loading skeleton until top-picks resolves.
Carry-over: HMAC verification on /api/zerodha/postback; JWT auth on WebSocket handshake.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1420 lines; split into routers/ package (auth, market, stocks, analysis, trades, portfolio, news, journal, zerodha, monitor, whatsapp).
Auto-login route returns a JWT cookie without any role/env guard — significant security risk if pushed to prod without flagging.
services/trade_journal.get_trade_journal computes `cutoff` but never uses it in the find() filter; days param is dead code.
services/news_service caches RSS responses at module scope without lock — concurrent requests may double-fetch on cache expiry (minor).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (News + Journal + Stock detail + Auto-login + Dashboard + Sidebar all OK; Picks Full-Report button not visually located but backend API works)
